//: Used only by the standalone Node scripts (worker, migrate, seed, doctor).
Deliberately does NOT extend tsconfig.json. tsx resolves `extends` with
Array.prototype.toReversed(), which does not exist before Node 20, and these
scripts must run on the Node version the project supports.
Its only real job is the `server-only` mapping: that package is a Next
build-time guard resolved inside a Next build, and these processes run
outside one. The app keeps the real guard, because Next reads tsconfig.json.
